### Cause

In [`outputLink`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/gemini_t6t2_r1/work/src/Tokenizer.ts#L16-L53) in [Tokenizer.ts](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/gemini_t6t2_r1/work/src/Tokenizer.ts), `lexer.state.inLink` was set to `true` before tokenizing the inner label text (`lexer.inlineTokens(text)`) and unconditionally reset to `false` afterward. When an image (inline or reference-style) was tokenized inside an outer link's label, the nested call to [`outputLink`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/gemini_t6t2_r1/work/src/Tokenizer.ts#L16-L53) reset `lexer.state.inLink` to `false` upon returning, causing [`#inlineTokensInner`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/gemini_t6t2_r1/work/src/Lexer.ts#L367-L557) in [Lexer.ts](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/gemini_t6t2_r1/work/src/Lexer.ts#L510-L515) to run `this.tokenizer.url(src)` on any subsequent bare URLs or email addresses inside the outer link.

### Fix

Updated [`outputLink`](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/gemini_t6t2_r1/work/src/Tokenizer.ts#L22-L30) in [Tokenizer.ts](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/gemini_t6t2_r1/work/src/Tokenizer.ts) to save the previous `lexer.state.inLink` value (`outerInLink`) and restore it after `lexer.inlineTokens(text)` completes.
